source_caption:
🎬 The Fundamentals of Caring (2016)

The Fundamentals of Caring follows Ben, a former writer struggling with personal tragedy who decides to become a caregiver in hopes of finding a new purpose in life. His first client is Trevor, a sarcastic teenager living with Duchenne muscular dystrophy who spends most of his time following a strict daily routine. Despite their differences, the two develop an unexpected friendship filled with humor, honesty, and emotional understanding. When they embark on a road trip to visit unusual roadside attractions, their journey takes an unexpected turn after they meet Dot, a rebellious young woman with struggles of her own. As they travel across America, the group experiences hilarious adventures, meaningful conversations, and moments of personal discovery. Starring Paul Rudd, Craig Roberts, and Selena Gomez, the film combines heartfelt comedy and emotional storytelling while exploring friendship, grief, compassion, independence, and the importance of moving forward.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 37m • TV-MA

🎥 Director: Rob Burnett

✍️ Writer: Rob Burnett, based on the novel The Revised Fundamentals of Caregiving by Jonathan Evison

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Fundamentals of Caring is a 2016 American road comedy-drama film written and directed by Rob Burnett, based on the 2012 novel The Revised Fundamentals of Caregiving by Jonathan Evison. Starring Paul Rudd, Craig Roberts, and Selena Gomez, the film had its world premiere at the Sundance Film Festival on January 29, 2016, and was released on Netflix on June 24, 2016.
